user.title: Choose an Echo Button
user.description: Echo Buttons already paired with this host (stock firmware), and buttons running AButton seen over Bluetooth LE.

pair.title: Pair an Echo Button
pair.description:
1. If the button is paired with an Echo, unplug that Echo for now.
2. Hold the Echo Button down until it glows **orange**. That takes 5–20 seconds; keep holding through any blue or green flashes.
3. Release it, then select **Submit**. The button stays in pairing mode for a couple of minutes.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: **{name}** runs AButton, the open Echo Button firmware. Home Assistant will control its LED and settings over Bluetooth LE. Its presses and battery come through the **BTHome** integration, which discovers it separately.

progress.pairing: Looking for an Echo Button in pairing mode and pairing with it. This can take up to 45 seconds.

error.not_found: No Echo Button in pairing mode was found. Make sure it glows orange, then select Submit again.
error.pair_failed: Pairing failed. Put the button back into pairing mode (orange) and try again.
error.bluez_unavailable: Could not reach the Bluetooth service (BlueZ) on this host.

abort.already_configured: This Echo Button is already set up (if it now runs AButton, its entry was switched over).
abort.bluez_unavailable: Could not reach the Bluetooth service (BlueZ), and no AButton was found. Stock buttons need a Bluetooth adapter on the Home Assistant host; AButtons need a connectable adapter or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy in active mode.

init.title: Echo Button options
init.description: The button flashes the press flash color the moment it's pressed (stock: blue; black turns the flash off). Then, after each short press, it glows the toggle's new state color and fades back.

data_description.press_color: The button's own short flash on every press. Home Assistant sets it each time the button connects. Black turns it off, which also keeps it from disturbing the feedback below.
data_description.keep_awake: The button goes to sleep after 10 idle minutes. The next press only wakes it and isn't reported; it reconnects about 2 seconds later. With this on, Home Assistant asks the button for its status regularly so it stays awake. This likely drains the batteries faster.
data_description.keep_awake_seconds: How often to ask for status while Keep awake is on (10–540 s). Must stay under the button's 10-minute sleep timer.

abutton.title: AButton settings
abutton.description: These settings are stored on the button. They are sent right away if the button is in range, otherwise on its next connection.

data_description.press_color: Black turns the press light off.
data_description.brightness: Scales every LED color, including the press light and animations (1–255).
data_description.long_press_ms: How long the button must be held for a long press.
data_description.multi_click_ms: How long the button waits for another click before reporting a press, double press or triple press. Shorter is snappier; longer is easier to double-click.
data_description.advert_interval_ms: How often the button broadcasts while idle. Longer saves battery; presses are always sent at once.
data_description.low_battery_pct: The battery level that counts as low.
data_description.low_battery_warning: Two red blinks after each press while the battery is low.
data_description.boot_battery: The power-up blink is green, amber or red by battery level instead of white.
data_description.restore_led: The button keeps the LED entity's color after a battery change or restart.
data_description.tx_power: Lower it only if the button is close to a Bluetooth adapter or proxy; −16 dBm arrives about 30 dB weaker than the maximum and shortens the range a lot.
data_description.sleep: Lets the chip sleep between events while the LED is off, to save battery. Presses still register at once; a steady LED color keeps it awake.

play_animation.name: Play animation
play_animation.description: Plays a light animation on an Echo Button, then returns to the LED entity's steady color (or off).

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: List of steps (up to 41 on stock firmware, 40 on AButton). Each has a color ([r, g, b] or "#rrggbb"), a duration in milliseconds (1–65535) and an optional fade (true fades into this step's color).

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: How many times to play the sequence (1–255). 0 plays it until the light is changed (AButton only).
